translationNotes: English copy is identical across en-AU, en-CA, en-GB and en-US; none of the source words needs regional spelling changes.
German Schön einfach, French Une belle simplicité, Spanish Sencillas y bonitas, and the corresponding Nordic/Asian phrases adapt Beautifully simple naturally rather than word for word.
Several search subtitles refer to tasks instead of literally translating plans, which makes checking items off natural in those languages. No additional feature claim is introduced.
All other-locale UI remains English as requested; localized marketing copy does not imply additional in-app UI languages.

Header titles were shortened for large two-line typography: Finnish Päiväsi muistiin (note your day), French Vos jours, en notes (your days in notes), Indonesian Harimu, catatanmu (your day, your notes), Japanese 一日を、メモに (a day in notes), and Swedish Din dag, med ord (your day in words).
Finnish and Swedish search titles remain the longest; preserve whole compound words while fitting actual font metrics.
Finnish header subtitle uses listat (lists) for the compact checklist reference, keeping large readable type in two lines.

CJK search copy has deliberate phrase-level breaks to prevent Japanese/Korean word fragments or a Chinese punctuation-only line. Japanese and Korean search headlines use three lines; Chinese shortens 备忘录/備忘錄 to 备忘/備忘 (notes).
Swedish search title uses four short complete phrases (take notes, make lists, beautiful, simple) to retain large type without splitting Anteckningar.
